comment: v4. Says 'AI Agent' throughout, frames the wider decision problem, covers telemetry + digital twin, names the Jev and LLM models, and puts reinforcement learning in the roadmap where it honestly belongs (it is not implemented yet).

phrases: And this is the problem it was built for.

phrases.text: Baladna's dairy complex in Adrar, the largest in the world.
phrases.say: Baladna's dairy complex in Adrar — the largest in the world.

phrases: Two hundred and seventy thousand cows,
across one hundred and seventeen thousand hectares.
Six specialist domains, all running at once, all producing telemetry.
No team can hold six domains in their head at the same time.
And the domains are coupled.
A bearing fails, a pivot stops, a field dries, the herd loses feed.

phrases.text: Every late decision compounds, in water, in yield, in animal welfare.
phrases.say: Every late decision compounds — in water, in yield, in animal welfare.

phrases: That is not a data problem. It is a decision problem.

phrases.text: So Aidustrial runs this operation with seven specialist AI Agents.
phrases.say: So idustrial runs this operation with seven specialist AI Agents.

phrases: Each AI Agent owns one domain, and never stops watching it.

phrases.text: They read a digital twin of the whole site,
phrases.say: They read a digital twin of the whole site —

phrases: pivots, silos, the parlour, weather, the labs.
The field AI Agent watches what grows.
The water AI Agent predicts quantity and tests quality.
The cow doctor AI Agent watches heat stress and disease.
The machine engineer AI Agent watches pivots, pumps and nozzles.

phrases.text: The milking, calving and supply AI Agents, all live.
phrases.say: The milking, calving and supply AI Agents — all running right now.

phrases: No AI Agent calls another directly.
The orchestrator wakes the specialists whose domains have changed,
carries their questions between them,
and waits for the swarm to converge before anything can reach a human.
Every question and answer is on the blackboard, in the open.
Two models do the reasoning.

phrases.text: The Jev model decides, typed questions, and a closed set of actions.
phrases.say: The Jev model decides — typed questions, and a closed set of actions.

phrases: It hands you the odds it was working from, in under a second.
The LLM model writes the explanation, so you can argue with it.
Neither of them sets the risk score. That is ours, computed by rule.
Most decisions never reach a person.

phrases.text: But anything carrying real risk goes to a human specialist,
phrases.say: But anything carrying real risk goes to a human specialist —

phrases: with the evidence, the blast radius, and the cost of doing nothing.
A model may raise a problem. It can never lower one past a rule.
Water here is more than a quantity problem.
The water lab tests quality continuously; the food lab reads the fields.
Every number carries the source it came from.
Every minute late on the milking line costs a lactation.

phrases.text: Aidustrial catches it while it is still minutes.
phrases.say: idustrial catches it while it is still minutes.

phrases: Thirty thousand Holsteins fly in from nine US states,
with Hunland and Scarff Bros.
The AI Agents are watching for animals that have not landed yet.
Nothing irreversible happens without you.
Every decision is written to an audit log you can read.
The twin is disposable. The tool boundary is the asset.
So what happens next?
Three months: one real barn group at Adrar,
live telemetry and the lab feeds,
four weeks in shadow mode.
PostgreSQL, multi-tenant access,
structured audit logging, and Neo4j for the knowledge graph.
Then reinforcement learning on real logs.
The core is built. This is the last mile.
And we would like an introduction to Baladna.
The same architecture fits any specialist industry.
Thank you. The demo and the code are on GitHub.
